'''2010 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Jerry Heine DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jerry Heine]] at [[2010 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Jerry
* '''Username:''' Sauce
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
